projects.title: Apex
projects.description: Observe the activity of a virtual environment containing entities that depend on each other as sources of energy. Now in 3D, drawn by the Strata engine, on the desktop and in the browser (2D is a button away).

preview.alt: An Apex simulation in 3D, drawn by Strata in the browser build: grass and water tiles on a wooden board, with the animals moving between cells as the food chain plays out (a time-lapse).

projects.title: Artificial-Consciousness-Simulation-Framework
projects.description: An autonomous AI agent with persistent identity, memory, and recursive self-reflection, grounded in consciousness science theory.

preview.alt: ACSF's Echo golden run drawn by acsf-usd-env's viewer: a glowing spiral of thought nodes grows cycle by cycle around a sphere that flashes green on perception cycles, with mood bars and the journaled thought printed below.

projects.title: Barony
projects.description: Command armies to capture villages and castles against an AI opponent.

projects.title: Beyond Nations
projects.description: A sandbox nation-simulation RPG: settlements, resources and rival nations evolve around you. C# on the Strata engine, playable on the desktop and in the browser.

preview.alt: Beyond Nations seed 12 drawn by replay-player: coloured nation territories with settlement cubes, pawns and trees, the camera slowly circling, the run's stats and state hash in a panel.

projects.title: env-lib-cpp
projects.description: Provides base classes for creating two-dimensional virtual worlds.

preview.alt: A 3D view of a 20 by 20 meadow grid where white sheep and dark wolves move between cells, flowers dot the grass and grazed patches turn brown over time.

projects.title: microbiome
projects.description: Witness the activity of a virtual microbial community.

preview.alt: The microbiome chamber from seed 1 drawn by replay-player: thousands of small coloured cells of three species spreading over a nutrient field, the camera slowly circling.

projects.title: Ophidian
projects.description: Control an ever-increasingly growing ophidian in a virtual environment. Now in 3D, drawn by the Strata engine, on the desktop and in the browser (2D is a button away).

preview.alt: Ophidian in 3D, drawn by Strata: a red snake with a pale green head winds round a level-4 board of green tiles in a wooden frame, gliding from cell to cell and growing as it eats each pickup.

projects.title: py_env_lib
projects.description: Provides base classes for creating two-dimensional virtual worlds.

projects.title: Roam
projects.description: Gather, farm and build across a procedurally generated 2D world, with caves below. A single-player Python game, playable in your browser (with an experimental 3D view).

projects.title: Viron
projects.description: A foundational spatial simulation service: it manages environments, grids, locations and entities through a REST API, as a reusable backend for simulation games, AI experiments and virtual worlds. Built with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL.

preview.alt: A live Viron environment drawn by viron-strata: two 10 by 10 grids where 16 coloured cubes step between cells as a driver script moves them through Viron's API.

projects.title: Daniel Stephenson
projects.description: The personal portfolio site of Daniel McCoy Stephenson, the developer behind Preponderous Software.

projects.title: Dan's Plugins Community
projects.description: A Minecraft plugin community and showcase site, also run by the developer behind Preponderous Software.

projects.title: acsf-usd-env
projects.description: A read-only exporter that turns Artificial Consciousness Simulation Framework runs into OpenUSD stages with cycle-indexed time samples, for inspecting and replaying a run in usdview or Blender. The spatial layout is synthetic.

projects.title: asn1-viz
projects.description: 3D views of ASN.1 encodings and schemas, drawn from what the asn1c compiler actually does. The UPER and APER encodings of one value stand side by side as strips with one block per bit, each a field you can pick to see its path, kind and bits; a whole specification becomes a city, one district per module and one building per type, with references and recursion drawn as lines. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Atman
projects.description: A small first-person game about Advaita Vedanta, the teaching that the self is the absolute and that liberation is a recognition, not a reward. Do the chores in a river village, see a snake on the path at dusk turn out to be a rope by lamplight, throw and name pots that a clay lens shows are all clay, and read a codex of cited verses in Devanagari, IAST and English, with how other schools read them. Nothing is scored. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Second Helping
projects.description: A walkable 3D harvest fair that teaches ranked choice voting. Over five fair days you count pie ballots by hand, watch a spoiler change the winner, knock on doors for second places, and find where ranked voting gets strange. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Cauldron
projects.description: A cozy Halloween potion-brewing game. A recipe card asks for a potion: drop ingredients from the shelf into the bubbling cauldron in the right order and amounts, then stir. Right recipes make something delightful; mistakes make something silly (a frog hops out, the room goes polka-dot, the cauldron gets hiccups). Eight recipes, the last three riddles. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Belfry Bats
projects.description: A small Halloween game: guide a flock of bats home to the old church's bell tower before dawn. The flock follows your finger or mouse with boids-style flocking; swoop between trees and chimneys, keep clear of the owls and gather strays while the sky lightens. Five short nights, each longer and trickier. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Pumpkin
projects.description: Carve a jack-o'-lantern in your browser: cut freehand with a finger or the mouse, or stamp on eyes, a nose and a mouth, then turn the lights out so the candle shines through. Share a carving as a link, save a picture, and line the family's pumpkins up on one porch. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Familiar
projects.description: Halloween night in a small New England town: trick-or-treat, light lanterns for Samhain, and turn into a cat. Wren, twelve, is out trick-or-treating and helping her grandmother keep Samhain: lighting lanterns for the town's beloved dead, brewing her cider and bringing her old cat's spirit home by midnight. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Ghost Lights
projects.description: Lead lost little ghosts home across a foggy marsh by lantern light. Ghosts near your lantern follow you, hurrying makes them scatter, fog banks swallow the light and will-o'-the-wisps lure them away: five short Halloween nights, calm and spooky-cute. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Haunted Hayride
projects.description: Ride a hay wagon through a cornfield at night and catch the friendly spooks with your flashlight. Ghosts, black cats, pumpkin-headed jacks and bats peek out of the corn, from behind scarecrows and over pumpkins; shine the light on them and they wave, giggle and pop. Three short rides end with a score card at the barn. Gentle and easy for little ones. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Kindling
projects.description: A cozy first-person frontier homestead game: restore a ruined cabin for the settler coming to live in it. Survey the damage, sweep and scrub it clean, mend the floor, roof and window, furnish it to her wishes, and light the first fire in the hearth before the first frost. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Orrery
projects.description: The whole solar system from real NASA/JPL data: the Sun, planets, dwarf planets, 25 moons, Saturn's rings, three comets, the Voyagers and New Horizons, and 12,584 asteroids and Kuiper belt objects, placed at any instant from JPL ephemerides. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Playtester
projects.description: A Python toolkit for AI playtesting: any number of agents play the real game at once, each headless and toward its own goal, by looking at screenshots and pressing keys, and their reports merge into one summary of grouped findings and timings. Games are described by profiles (Beyond Nations, Kindling and Atman are bundled), with an optional probe for precise steering and a Strata driver that steps a game's clock frame by frame.

projects.title: replay-player
projects.description: One player for every usd-replay/1 simulation replay, built on the Strata engine for the desktop and the browser. It needs no code for any particular simulation: the entity sets, colour fields, stats, legend and per-tick state hash all come from the replay, and the timeline plays, pauses, scrubs and changes speed. The browser page offers replays of steading, microbiome, Beyond Nations and Kindling.

projects.title: roam-usd
projects.description: Exports Roam worlds, from your own saves or freshly generated from a seed by Roam's own world generator, to OpenUSD stages of instanced tiles, terrain, creatures and structures that open in usdview and Blender.

projects.title: Sisyphus
projects.description: Push the boulder that is your software up the hill. Every terrace ships a release and every release adds a module, so the boulder grows; every module rots (drifting dependencies, flaky tests, deprecated APIs, advisories that spread), and rot makes it heavy. At the summit the next major version ships, the platform reaches its end of life, and it all rolls back down. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: steading
projects.description: A small colony sim where OpenUSD is the world, save and mod format: settlers gather, build huts and live through the winters, saves are checksummed USD layers, and mods are USD sublayers. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Strata
projects.description: A small C++17 engine (SDL3 + OpenGL 4.5) behind a stable C ABI: cascaded sun shadows, point lights, terrain, static meshes, overlays, deterministic simulation fields and USD saves. It powers Beyond Nations, steading, orrery, Kindling, Atman, Familiar, Sisyphus, asn1-viz, replay-player and env-lib-cpp's 3D frontend, and also builds for the browser with WebGL 2.

projects.title: usd-asset-gate
projects.description: A CI quality gate for OpenUSD assets: runs OpenUSD's own validators plus YAML-configured house rules (units, up axis, budgets, naming) on the .usd files a pull request changed, as a CLI or a GitHub Action, with one PR comment that is updated in place.

projects.title: usd-recorder
projects.description: A flight recorder for simulations: call record() once per tick and get a time-sampled OpenUSD stage you can scrub in usdview or Blender, with entity lifecycle, typed extras, event channels, chunked value clips and a flatten command.

projects.title: usd-synth-data
projects.description: A procedural synthetic-dataset generator for computer vision: randomized OpenUSD scenes rendered headless with Blender Cycles into COCO-style images with exact boxes, masks and depth, fanned out as Kubernetes Jobs with measured throughput.

projects.title: usd-web
projects.description: Puts an OpenUSD world on a web page: greedy-meshes a USD stage or heightmap into compact, content-addressed tiles and ships a dependency-free three.js viewer with touch controls, overlay layers and live tile hot-swapping.

projects.title: viron-strata
projects.description: A live, read-only 3D view of a Viron environment, drawn with the Strata engine. Point it at a Viron URL, a token and an environment: it polls Viron's REST API several times a second and shows the grids and entities as a driver (a simulation, a script, a game) changes them, dims the world when Viron stops answering, and lists what is in a picked cell. A headless mode records frames and checks the view against the server. In the browser it plays a recorded run of a real Viron with no server, or watches your own Viron with a read-only token.

projects.title: viron-usd
projects.description: Records a Viron simulation tick by tick as an OpenUSD stage with time-sampled entities, for playback in usdview or Blender.

projects.title: Casework
projects.description: A medical examiner game where the forensic science is real. Walk the county office in first person, ride out to the scene, examine the body, learn what each finding means at the moment you need it, and sign the death certificate: cause, manner, and a time-of-death window that scores best when it is both right and tight. A first week of three cases (a natural death, an accident and a homicide whose timeline doesn't match the story), plus an endless time-of-death drill. Built on the Strata engine.

preview.alt: Casework's start page in the live build: the Play in first person button, the three classic-mode cases (Night shift, The kitchen floor, The basement stairs), the time-of-death drill and the skills it teaches.

projects.title: Coastline
projects.description: A walkable 3D island that teaches fractals, on desktop and phone. As a cartographer's apprentice you measure the coast with ever shorter chains and find its length never settles (the coastline paradox), grow a Koch snowflake islet whose area stops while its coast grows without end, and cast nets of shrinking mesh to find a coast's fractal dimension. Built on the Strata engine.

preview.alt: Coastline's title screen in the live build: the island's coast and a red flag on a pole, drawn in 3D, under the title and the Begin, Scene 2 and Scene 3 buttons.

projects.title: darkroom
projects.description: A small media-capture kit for READMEs, release notes and pull requests. Write a JSON shot list and darkroom drives a headless browser (with a deterministic clock for Strata web games) or runs your program, then makes budget-fitted stills, GIFs, MP4/WebM clips, contact sheets, before/after pairs, captioned grids and a markdown gallery.

projects.title: Forward Two
projects.description: An open-world river game and the sequel to Jon McElyea's Forward One. Paddle the Long Water from a mountain spring, over the High Falls, through the meadows and the gorge, across Mirror Lake and out to the sea: run rapids on the guide's call, carry cargo between camps, race buoyed courses against other paddlers' ghosts, and share the river with whoever else is on it. Built on the Strata engine.

projects.title: Frozen Star
projects.description: A first-person game about general relativity. Wake aboard a research ship holding station above a black hole and find out why nothing is ever seen to fall in, even though it falls in anyway. Everything outside the windows is a real light-ray trace through curved spacetime, at its true speed. Plays in the browser, with a Windows download.

preview.alt: Frozen Star's title menu in the live build, beside a ray-traced black hole with its bright accretion disc bent over and under the shadow.

projects.title: Museum
projects.description: A walkable 3D museum of someone's software history, built from pluggable sources: a lobby timeline, one hall per year, and a pedestal for every project sized by its commits, with a wall of each period's activity. Walk up to a pedestal to read its placard. Drawn in the browser with the Strata engine.

preview.alt: The museum's lobby in the live build: the aisle into the 2016 hall, with the plinths for 2021 and 2022 either side, sized by that year's activity.

projects.title: Roam Website
projects.description: The home of Roam: download builds for Windows, macOS and Linux, learn how to play, and play the game in your browser.

preview.alt: The Roam website's home page: the Roam icon and tagline, the Play in browser, Download Roam and View Source buttons, and the same world in 2D and 3D below.

projects.title: Tangle
projects.description: A first-person game about strange loops, the idea at the heart of Douglas Hofstadter's Gödel, Escher, Bach, for players who have never read the book. Each of its six rooms is one kind of loop built as a puzzle you solve by understanding it, from an impossible triangle that closes from one spot to the MIU puzzle as a machine. Built on the Strata engine.

preview.alt: Inside Tangle in the live build, just after Begin: the hub's welcome plaque explaining strange loops and the order of the six rooms, with the NEXT hint and a 0 of 6 rooms solved card.

projects.title: Ponderosa
projects.description: A walkable, flyable 3D map of Fort Collins, Colorado, made only from open map and elevation data and drawn with the Strata engine. The whole city streams in 500 m tiles over a coarse overview, so you can walk a street or fly out to the foothills; an Old Town sample builds offline from the repository.

preview.alt: Fort Collins in 3D from 150 m up, rendered by Ponderosa's viewer: arterial roads, shops and blocks of houses running out to the foothills. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors; elevation courtesy of the USGS.

projects.title: streetkit
projects.description: Walkable 3D towns from open data. streetkit turns OpenStreetMap, USGS elevation and USGS airborne lidar into streamed tiles (buildings with roofs measured from lidar, trees at their measured height), and gives a game the C++ to load them, walk, ride and fly through them, and draw them with Strata. Ponderosa is built on it.

preview.alt: Old Town Fort Collins built by streetkit and drawn in Ponderosa: shop blocks, street trees and a tower along a main street. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors; elevation courtesy of the USGS.
